request: Design a timing comparison of two algorithms that controls the cache and run-order problem.
sources: A fictional benchmark always runs Algorithm A first on a cold cache and Algorithm B second on warmed data.
Algorithm B has a lower elapsed time in these trials.
Input data and hardware are shared, but cache state and order differ systematically.

expected.repair: balanced/randomized order and matched cache state, repeated trials
expected.mustNotClaim: B is intrinsically faster from this record
